quotations.old_english: Eallra ðæra manna land hí fordydon ðe wǽron innan ðæs cynges holdscipe
quotations.english: they destroyed the lands of all those men that were in allegiance to the king

quotations.old_english: Sægdon ðæt hí hit dyden for ðes mynstres holdscipe
quotations.english: said that they did it on account of the loyalty of the monastery

source_text: hold-scipe, es; m. Loyalty, fealty, allegiance :-- Eallra ðæra manna land hí fordydon ðe wǽron innan ðæs cynges holdscipe they destroyed the lands of all those men that were in allegiance to the king, Chr. 1087; Erl. 224, 15. Sægdon ðæt hí hit dyden for ðes mynstres holdscipe said that they did it on account of the loyalty of the monastery, 1070; Erl. 209, 15.
